negative_reviews.author: C
negative_reviews.text:
We have visited Maki & Ramen five times now, and unfortunately the level of service has been very inconsistent. Our visit yesterday was by far the worst and has left us deciding not to return.

We were a family of five, and I joined the group shortly after finishing work. We asked if we could move from our table to an available booth as it offered more space for our party. We were told this was not possible because our food order had already been assigned to the table and we would need to wait until all the food had arrived before moving. This made little sense to us as the booth was directly next to our table.

What made the situation more frustrating was that the booth was later given to a group of three, while our party of five had to squeeze around two small tables with dishes balanced across them. With a bill of around £120, I would expect a better level of customer service and a little more flexibility where possible.

In addition, the member of staff we spoke to had a very noticeable body odour, which was unfortunately apparent whenever food was brought to the table. I appreciate this may be an uncomfortable issue to raise, but when customers are dining, hygiene and presentation are important parts of the experience.

Throughout the meal, no one checked whether we were okay despite the obvious lack of space, and no effort was made to revisit the request or offer any alternative solution. After visiting several times previously, it is disappointing that our final experience was so poor.

The food itself was enjoyable, but the service and overall experience left a very negative impression. Sadly, after five visits, we will not be returning.
